summary: Provides core capabilities for initializing project and workspace contexts, discovering configuration files, loading and caching Python modules, and managing file analysis metadata.
responsibilities: Initialize project and workspace context for Python analysis.
Discover workspace roots and parse project configuration files.
Load and analyze Python modules and source files.
Manage module caches and file analysis context.
Create and register file and class metadata.
relationships: Initialization, workspace management, module loading, cache management, and metadata registration work together to support Python project analysis.
design_decisions: Modularized functionality for project initialization, workspace discovery, module loading, and metadata handling.
